image_note: Four phases use USB3300 Table 6-6 low-power direct DATA[1:0] LineState outputs: dual pulldown, FS pullup, LS pullup, dual pulldown. The independent 50 MHz domain verifies CLKOUT stopped and DIR high, then samples synchronized DATA[1:0] after settling. Each phase has sixteen samples; masks include all states observed, not a pass/fail judgment of the expected line value. Validation flags separately record sampling, stop, wake and register-readback completion. STP wakes the PHY after each phase and final FC41/IF00/OTG06 is detached. All payload and metadata snapshots are committed in the 50 MHz domain, so capture continues while CLKOUT is absent. This image runs no USB device protocol and does not prove enumeration.
note: Lowpower uses a distinct 50 MHz-only status layout. The low 32 bits contain stage[15:8] and flags[7:3], not a measured PHY frequency. Each page lasts eight samples; all four payloads and metadata commit together before page 0. A zero direct mask means no samples, not SE0. CSV has no GAO identity; match it to the capture manifest. Time labels do not establish USB bit timing.
